title: A Border for the Debt
author: Ivo Yarrow
blurb: Silas Pemberton, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, has spent seven years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
